motions.motion_text:
Adequacy of Supervision
Effective supervision is integral to a positive workplace culture, to organizational integrity, and to the early identification of conduct, whether matters properly addressed through coaching and developmental supervision or matters warranting formal escalation and accountability. Supervision is equally integral to the identification of, and response to, member wellness concerns.
